children: AeroVironment received a $464.8 million contract from the U.S. Army to provide dozens of its LOCUST X3 laser-based counter-drone systems over multiple years.
The company said the contract represents the first-ever procurement of directed energy system in U.S. history and signals a shift toward laser-based weapons systems.

"This award marks a defining moment not only for AV, but for the future of modern defense," Chief Executive Wahid Nawabi said. "The transition of directed energy from experimentation to an enduring, fielded capability reflects years of collaboration, innovation, and operational success alongside the U.S. Army."
The production of the systems will be supported by a $30 million investment in the company's facility in Albuquerque, N.M., announced earlier this year.
